findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "check_endpoint" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: discover_monitored_apis, check_endpoint · Private data: discover_monitored_apis, check_pass, buy_pass, create_escrow_job, register_escrow_terms, get_escrow_job, get_usdc_escrow_contract · Public sink: discover_monitored_apis, check_endpoint, buy_pass.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: discover_monitored_apis, check_endpoint · Private data: discover_monitored_apis, check_pass, buy_pass, create_escrow_job, register_escrow_terms, get_escrow_job, get_usdc_escrow_contract · Public sink: discover_monitored_apis, check_endpoint, buy_pass

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
